rationale: RIOT has already gapped up 11.38% and is trading at 70.5% of its intraday range with price sitting just below the 9-EMA ($15.93) and showing small-bodied, low-conviction candles over the last five minutes — no clear directional momentum. The broad market is strongly risk-on (SPY +1.86%, VIXY -9.33%) which supports the gap, but with no news catalyst, 148 minutes remaining, and a working order already consuming 2% of buying power, adding exposure to a high-beta name that has already made its primary move offers an unfavorable risk/reward profile at this stage.
